reconcile.note: Gill reads John's greatness and the kingdom's least as a comparison of degrees of revealed doctrine, not of persons ranked on one scale.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogs Solomon, Jesus, John, and the humbled child as four incompatible answers to who is greatest, without resolving the frames apart.

sides.snippet: behold, I have done according to your word: behold, I have given you a wise and an understanding heart; so that there has been none like you before you, neither after you shall any arise like you.
sides.verseText: behold, I have done according to your word: behold, I have given you a wise and an understanding heart; so that there has been none like you before you, neither after you shall any arise like you.

sides.snippet: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
sides.verseText: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.
